claim_boundary: All architecture labels below are development-stage/candidate unless a source explicitly freezes the corresponding role. Internal verification does not equal empirical psychometric validation.

measurement_question.ru: Как человек выражает, получает, уточняет, согласовывает и восстанавливает сексуально или эротически значимую коммуникацию?
measurement_question.en: How does a person express, receive, clarify, negotiate and repair sexually or erotically meaningful communication?

scientific_role.ru: COM-12 изолирует межличностную операцию коммуникации от мотивации, привязанности, внутреннего чувства агентности, содержания предпочтений и downstream-исходов.
scientific_role.en: COM-12 isolates the interpersonal communication operation from motivation, attachment, internal agency, preference content and downstream outcomes.

development_history.public_note_ru: Исходный пул был построен шире предполагаемой короткой формы, чтобы допустить конкуренцию и удаление контаминированных формулировок.
development_history.public_note_en: The initial pool was intentionally broader than the intended short form so contaminated or redundant content could compete and be removed.

development_history.verdict: 32 → 24 cognitive candidate / PASS FOR CONTINUED DEVELOPMENT
development_history.public_note_ru: Item-level аудит проверял чистоту конструкта, double-barreling, поведенческую доступность, partner contamination, overlap с P-120, социальную желательность, response-process clarity и N/A burden.
development_history.public_note_en: Item-level review examined construct purity, double-barreling, behavioral accessibility, partner contamination, P-120 overlap, social desirability, response-process clarity and N/A burden.

development_history.public_note_ru: Были определены экспертная оценка, CVI-архитектура, когнитивные failure codes и предварительные Tier A/B/C роли; Tier A не является финальным COM-12.
development_history.public_note_en: Expert review, CVI architecture, cognitive failure codes and preliminary Tier A/B/C roles were defined; Tier A is not a final COM-12.

development_history.verdict: FIELD EXECUTION PROTOCOL READY / EVIDENCE PENDING
development_history.public_note_ru: C1 comprehension, C2 construct discrimination и C3 full-form/burden/sensitive-flow процедуры готовы; реальные field observations ещё не заменены симуляцией и требуются для следующего freeze adjudication.
development_history.public_note_en: C1 comprehension, C2 construct discrimination and C3 full-form/burden/sensitive-flow procedures are ready; real field observations remain required before freeze adjudication.

internal_verification.claim: 32-item pool reduced to a 24-item cognitive candidate through explicit item-level red-team criteria.
E/R/N/P candidate domains have explicit hard boundaries and are not treated as confirmed factors.
EXT-SYS firewalls distinguish COM-N from SELF-SAA, COM-P from P-72D erotic re-engagement, COM-P from LIFE-CCO, and COM operations from AO/MOT/RPE ownership.
C1-C2-C3 field execution and evidence adjudication protocol is controlled; observations remain pending.

ownership_boundaries.distinction_ru: SELF-SAA — внутреннее авторство сексуального выбора; COM-N — способность сообщать и согласовывать этот выбор с другим человеком.
ownership_boundaries.distinction_en: SELF-SAA concerns internal authorship of sexual choices; COM-N concerns communicating and negotiating those choices with another person.

ownership_boundaries.distinction_ru: Восстановление эротического вовлечения после нарушения не равно возвращению к коммуникации после сексуального недопонимания или напряжения.
ownership_boundaries.distinction_en: Restoration of erotic engagement after disruption is not the same as returning to communication after sexual misunderstanding or tension.

ownership_boundaries.distinction_ru: Привязанность регулирует security/threat; COM измеряет коммуникационный процесс. Attachment insecurity может влиять на коммуникацию, но не определяет COM-конструкт.
ownership_boundaries.distinction_en: Attachment regulates security/threat; COM measures the communication process. Attachment insecurity may influence communication but does not define the COM construct.

ownership_boundaries.distinction_ru: MOT отвечает, почему человек выбирает близость; COM — как он выражает, получает и согласовывает сексуально значимую информацию.
ownership_boundaries.distinction_en: MOT asks why intimacy is chosen; COM asks how sexually meaningful information is expressed, received and negotiated.

modules.next_gate: COM-12 v0.9 only after actual C1/C2/C3 evidence: Post-Field Evidence Consolidation & Pilot Candidate Freeze Adjudication.

limitations.ru: E/R/N/P — кандидатная архитектура, а не подтверждённые факторы.
limitations.en: E/R/N/P are candidate domains, not confirmed factors.

limitations.ru: Производственный scoring, norms и participant interpretation не разрешены.
limitations.en: Production scoring, norms and participant interpretation are not authorized.

limitations.ru: Когнитивная готовность протокола не является доказательством reliability или validity.
limitations.en: Cognitive protocol readiness is not evidence of reliability or psychometric validity.

source_bindings.role: development history, candidate domains and ownership firewalls

publication.claim_ceiling: candidate architecture + development/verification record; no empirical validity claim

measurement_question.ru: Почему — ради какого ожидаемого психологического результата — человек выбирает сексуально или эротически значимую близость?
measurement_question.en: Why — for what anticipated psychological result — does a person choose sexual or erotically significant intimacy?

scientific_role.ru: MOT-12 отделяет причины выбора близости от силы желания, триггеров активации, поведения, привязанности, коммуникационной способности, самооценки и downstream-исходов.
scientific_role.en: MOT-12 separates reasons for choosing intimacy from desire strength, activation triggers, behavior, attachment, communication ability, self-appraisal and downstream outcomes.

development_history.public_note_ru: Было зафиксировано desire ≠ activation ≠ motivation ≠ behavior; после red-team добавлен отдельный coping/affect-regulation territory и введены cross-cutting metadata.
development_history.public_note_en: The programme established desire ≠ activation ≠ motivation ≠ behavior; red-team work added a distinct coping/affect-regulation territory and cross-cutting metadata.

development_history.public_note_ru: Широкий development pool сохранил конкурирующие motive families и relationship-contextual scope.
development_history.public_note_en: A broad development pool preserved competing motive families under relationship-contextual scope.

development_history.public_note_ru: Item-by-item red-team атаковал чистоту, redundancy, desire/P-72/P-72D/AO/COM/SELF/LIFE contamination, social/moral desirability, scope, consent reinterpretation и N/A risk.
development_history.public_note_en: Item-by-item red-team examined purity, redundancy, desire/P-72/P-72D/AO/COM/SELF/LIFE contamination, social/moral desirability, scope, consent reinterpretation and N/A risk.

development_history.verdict: PASS TO EXECUTION / PRE-PILOT ACCEPTANCE GATE NOT YET EXECUTED
development_history.public_note_ru: Определены blinded expert review, CVI, cognitive interview, direct contrasts и kill/merge adjudication; реальные expert ratings и respondent observations ещё требуются.
development_history.public_note_en: Blinded expert review, CVI, cognitive interviews, direct contrasts and kill/merge adjudication are defined; real expert ratings and respondent observations remain required.

internal_verification.claim: Desire, activation, motivation and behavior are explicitly separated in the development architecture.
36 initial items were reduced to a 24-item cognitive candidate with a 12-item traceable desk reserve.
Each candidate family is required to add information after its nearest P-120 owner is known; MOT-V has no short-form entitlement and remains a challenge construct.
Expert/CVI/cognitive discrimination programme is controlled; empirical content-validity and response-process evidence remain pending.

ownership_boundaries.distinction_ru: P-72/P-72D описывают WHAT activates и HOW activation changes; MOT-H/Exploration спрашивает WHY человек выбирает опыт.
ownership_boundaries.distinction_en: P-72/P-72D describe WHAT activates and HOW activation changes; MOT-H/Exploration asks WHY the person chooses the experience.

ownership_boundaries.distinction_ru: MOT-C — цель искать/выражать близость; AO — standing attachment/security regulation.
ownership_boundaries.distinction_en: MOT-C is a goal to seek/express closeness; AO is standing attachment/security regulation.

ownership_boundaries.distinction_ru: MOT-V — использование близости как средства получить подтверждение; SELF-PSD/SRG/SSH — более устойчивое самоотношение и самооценка.
ownership_boundaries.distinction_en: MOT-V uses intimacy to obtain validation; SELF-PSD/SRG/SSH concern standing self-appraisal and self-relation.

ownership_boundaries.distinction_ru: MOT-K — почему человек вступает в близость ради изменения состояния; LIFE — какое downstream-состояние наблюдается после/вокруг близости.
ownership_boundaries.distinction_en: MOT-K asks why intimacy is chosen to regulate state; LIFE asks what downstream state is observed around/after intimacy.

modules.next_gate: MOT-12 v0.6 — Expert Content-Validity & Cognitive Field Execution / Evidence Adjudication.

limitations.ru: Candidate families не являются подтверждённой factor structure.
limitations.en: Candidate families are not a confirmed factor structure.

limitations.ru: MOT-V остаётся conditional/challenge и может быть удалён при отсутствии incremental value после SELF + AO.
limitations.en: MOT-V remains conditional/challenge content and may be dropped if it adds no incremental value after SELF + AO.

limitations.ru: MOT Total и healthy/unhealthy motivation classification запрещены.
limitations.en: A MOT Total and healthy/unhealthy motivation classification are prohibited.

source_bindings.role: current pre-pilot architecture and exact next gate
PASS1-4 development lineage and construct states
system ownership and empirical co-validation handoff

publication.claim_ceiling: candidate motive architecture + development/verification record; no confirmed factors or scoring

measurement_question.ru: Как человек переживает, оценивает и авторствует себя как сексуального субъекта?
measurement_question.en: How does a person experience, evaluate and author themselves as a sexual subject?

scientific_role.ru: SELF-12 измеряет sexual self-relation как отдельный слой, не превращая его в general self-esteem, body-image, communication, attachment, motivation, embodied awareness или preference scale.
scientific_role.en: SELF-12 measures sexual self-relation as a distinct layer without turning it into general self-esteem, body image, communication, attachment, motivation, embodied awareness or preference measurement.

development_history.public_note_ru: Начальный landscape был намеренно широким и включал self-regard, legitimacy, agency, self-efficacy, self-consciousness, shame, desirability, body/genital image, self-knowledge и authenticity territories.
development_history.public_note_en: The initial landscape was intentionally broad, spanning self-regard, legitimacy, agency, self-efficacy, self-consciousness, shame, desirability, body/genital image, self-knowledge and authenticity territories.

development_history.public_note_ru: Self-efficacy был demoted, acceptance/pride merged into SRG, self-knowledge transferred to research reserve, authenticity retained only as derived bridge; 5 CORE + PSD/SBA LIMITED remained for development.
development_history.public_note_en: Self-efficacy was demoted, acceptance/pride merged into SRG, self-knowledge transferred to research reserve, and authenticity retained only as a derived bridge; 5 CORE + PSD/SBA LIMITED remained for development.

development_history.public_note_ru: Desk-stage item competition preserved explicit boundary probes rather than removing every overlap-sensitive item.
development_history.public_note_en: Desk-stage item competition preserved explicit boundary probes rather than removing every overlap-sensitive item.

development_history.verdict: PASS TO EXECUTION / FIELD EXECUTION OPEN / EVIDENCE PENDING
development_history.public_note_ru: Expert/CVI/C1-C3 architecture and ten direct discrimination territories are controlled; PASS 7 cannot close without real expert and respondent records.
development_history.public_note_en: Expert/CVI/C1-C3 architecture and ten direct discrimination territories are controlled; PASS 7 cannot close without real expert and respondent records.

internal_verification.claim: Broad initial territory was pruned through explicit ownership adjudication to 5 CORE candidate dimensions plus 2 LIMITED candidates.
29-item desk bank was reduced to 21 cognitive candidates with 8 traceable reserve items.
Ten direct red-team contrasts test SELF against COM, P-72D, SOMA, AO, MOT and RPE ownership.
PSD and SBA carry stricter information-gain requirements and default toward demotion/drop if distinctness is weak.
Execution system is complete, but expert content-validity and respondent response-process evidence remain pending.

ownership_boundaries.distinction_ru: SELF-SAA — субъективное авторство/владение выбором; COM-N — способность сообщать и согласовывать этот выбор.
ownership_boundaries.distinction_en: SELF-SAA concerns subjective authorship/ownership of choice; COM-N concerns communicating and negotiating that choice.

ownership_boundaries.distinction_ru: SELF-SSC — self-monitoring/self-consciousness; SOMA — awareness/differentiation собственного телесного эротического ответа.
ownership_boundaries.distinction_en: SELF-SSC concerns sexual self-monitoring/self-consciousness; SOMA concerns awareness/differentiation of embodied erotic response.

ownership_boundaries.distinction_ru: SELF-SSH — shame/negative sexual-self evaluation; AO — attachment threat/security regulation.
ownership_boundaries.distinction_en: SELF-SSH concerns shame/negative sexual-self evaluation; AO concerns attachment threat/security regulation.

ownership_boundaries.distinction_ru: SELF-PSD — baseline appraisal собственной желанности; MOT-V — выбор близости ради получения подтверждения желанности.
ownership_boundaries.distinction_en: SELF-PSD is baseline appraisal of desirability; MOT-V is choosing intimacy to obtain validation of desirability.

ownership_boundaries.distinction_ru: SELF-SBA — собственная sexual body appraisal; SOMA измеряет embodied response, RPE — специфические physical/reward preferences.
ownership_boundaries.distinction_en: SELF-SBA is appraisal of one's own sexual body; SOMA measures embodied response and RPE measures specific physical/reward preferences.

modules.next_gate: Close SELF-12 PASS 7 only after real expert E1/E2 and respondent C1-C3 evidence; later pilot-candidate freeze is conditional on that gate.

limitations.ru: 5 CORE + 2 LIMITED — development architecture, не подтверждённая factor structure.
limitations.en: 5 CORE + 2 LIMITED is a development architecture, not a confirmed factor structure.

limitations.ru: PSD и SBA остаются LIMITED и могут быть demoted/dropped.
limitations.en: PSD and SBA remain LIMITED and may be demoted/dropped.

limitations.ru: SELF Total, Agency Total и Validation Total запрещены.
limitations.en: SELF Total, Agency Total and Validation Total are prohibited.

source_bindings.role: exact 21-item cognitive candidate and 8-item reserve lineage
construct dictionary, expert/CVI/cognitive architecture and ten contrasts
field execution package; empirical gate remains open

publication.claim_ceiling: candidate architecture + controlled execution readiness; no empirical content-validity/factor claim

measurement_question.ru: Какие более широкие аффективные, энергетические, когнитивные, восстановительные, деятельностные или смысловые состояния наблюдаются вокруг и после интимного опыта?
measurement_question.en: What broader affective, energetic, cognitive, restorative, engagement or meaning-related states are observed around and after intimacy?

scientific_role.ru: LIFE — отдельный outcome/spillover layer. Он измеряет downstream-состояния во времени, а не причину вступления в близость, не psychosexual trait и не причинный эффект интимности.
scientific_role.en: LIFE is a separate outcome/spillover layer. It measures downstream states over time, not motives for intimacy, psychosexual traits or a causal effect of intimacy.

development_history.public_note_ru: Первичный landscape включал affect, vitality, cognition, sleep/restoration, social/work engagement, meaning, global satisfaction, distress и relationship climate.
development_history.public_note_en: The initial landscape included affect, vitality, cognition, sleep/restoration, social/work engagement, meaning, global satisfaction, distress and relationship climate.

development_history.verdict: 12 → 8 respondent territories → 6 CORE + CCO auxiliary; GLS externalized
development_history.public_note_ru: Relationship satisfaction была передана dyadic/relationship architecture, distress — внешнему валидатору, social openness — reserve/external; EXT-SYS затем externalized GLS.
development_history.public_note_en: Relationship satisfaction was transferred to dyadic/relationship architecture, distress to an external validator, social openness to reserve/external; EXT-SYS later externalized GLS.

development_history.verdict: 30 initial temporal items → 24 temporal cognitive candidates
development_history.public_note_ru: Кандидаты разнесены по temporal modes и проходят boundary/redundancy competition; LIFE-12 не форсируется до empirical reduction.
development_history.public_note_en: Candidates are separated by temporal mode and undergo boundary/redundancy competition; LIFE-12 is not forced before empirical reduction.

development_history.verdict: FIELD EXECUTION READY / EMPIRICAL EVIDENCE PENDING
development_history.public_note_ru: T0/T1/T3 C1-C2-C3 execution system готов; отсутствие реальных respondent records не заменяется синтетическими данными.
development_history.public_note_en: The T0/T1/T3 C1-C2-C3 execution system is ready; absent respondent records are not replaced with synthetic data.

internal_verification.claim: Outcome territories were pruned and separated from motivation, attachment, communication, SELF, SOMA, P-72D and RPE ownership.
T0 immediate/same-day, T1 next-day and T3 recent-pattern modes are distinct administration objects and cannot be silently flattened.
A 30-item temporal source bank was reduced to 24 cognitive candidates with explicit causal-attribution and overlap controls.
Event/opportunity/role eligibility and N/A states are required so lack of exposure is not interpreted as a low outcome.
Field protocol is ready; actual response-process evidence remains pending.

ownership_boundaries.distinction_ru: MOT-K — почему близость выбирается ради изменения состояния; LIFE — какое состояние наблюдается downstream.
ownership_boundaries.distinction_en: MOT-K asks why intimacy is chosen to change state; LIFE asks what state is observed downstream.

ownership_boundaries.distinction_ru: AO — attachment/security regulation; LIFE-NAL/CCO — более широкие downstream affect/cognition states.
ownership_boundaries.distinction_en: AO concerns attachment/security regulation; LIFE-NAL/CCO concern broader downstream affect/cognition states.

ownership_boundaries.distinction_ru: COM-P — способность возобновить коммуникацию; LIFE-CCO — продолжительность когнитивного carryover/rumination.
ownership_boundaries.distinction_en: COM-P is capacity to reopen communication; LIFE-CCO is persistence of cognitive carryover/rumination.

ownership_boundaries.distinction_ru: SOMA — embodied erotic response; LIFE-SV/SLP — общая vitality/sleep downstream.
ownership_boundaries.distinction_en: SOMA concerns embodied erotic response; LIFE-SV/SLP concern general downstream vitality/sleep.

ownership_boundaries.distinction_ru: Совпадающее временное окно не делает post-event erotic dynamics и broader life outcomes одним конструктом.
ownership_boundaries.distinction_en: A shared time window does not make post-event erotic dynamics and broader life outcomes the same construct.

modules.next_gate: Execute controlled LIFE C1→C2→C3 cycle; pilot-candidate freeze preparation is conditional on a later evidence-bearing gate.

limitations.ru: 6 CORE — development architecture, не подтверждённая six-factor model.
limitations.en: The 6 CORE dimensions are a development architecture, not a confirmed six-factor model.
CCO remains LIMITED/AUXILIARY; GLS is externalized.

limitations.ru: LIFE не может использовать causal language и не имеет LIFE Total.
limitations.en: LIFE cannot use causal language and has no LIFE Total.

limitations.ru: T0/T1/T3 нельзя сворачивать в одну generic administration.
limitations.en: T0/T1/T3 cannot be collapsed into one generic administration.

source_bindings.role: field execution, temporal-mode and evidence-state authority
CCO information-gain and GLS externalization decisions

publication.claim_ceiling: candidate outcome architecture + temporal/development record; no causal or psychometric validity claim

measurement_question.ru: Какие специфические физические и reward-based предпочтения могут быть измерены как отдельные координаты, не смешиваясь с активацией, embodied response, коммуникацией, мотивацией или outcomes?
measurement_question.en: Which specific physical and reward-based preferences can be measured as distinct coordinates without collapsing into activation, embodied response, communication, motivation or outcomes?

scientific_role.ru: RPE-MOD сохранён как добровольный 18+ optional Extended layer. Его функция — отдельная preference/reward architecture; значения других модулей присоединяются только после независимого измерения.
scientific_role.en: RPE-MOD is retained as a voluntary adult-only optional Extended layer. Its role is a distinct preference/reward architecture; other module outputs are joined only after independent measurement.

modules.construct_publication_note: Detailed RPE construct-family publication is withheld in PASS 4 because PASS 10 retains NO_PUBLICATION_PREPILOT / no respondent-facing scientific report at the current stage. The internal architecture remains controlled and available to governance, not public rendering.

development_history.public_note_ru: Широкая исходная идея была последовательно расширена, атакована, сокращена и safety-constrained; PASS 10 закрепил placement и ownership, но не psychometric validity, final wording, norms или field release.
development_history.public_note_en: The broad initial concept was progressively expanded, attacked, pruned and safety-constrained; PASS 10 freezes placement and ownership, not psychometric validity, final wording, norms or field release.

development_history.public_note_ru: Интеграция в Core и scored migration в SOMA отвергнуты; отдельный optional/adaptive placement признан наиболее защищающим construct distinctness, burden и privacy.
development_history.public_note_en: Core integration and scored migration into SOMA were rejected; separate optional/adaptive placement best preserves construct distinctness, burden and privacy.

internal_verification.claim: PASS 10 freezes RPE placement as a distinct optional Extended layer while preserving existing Core/SOMA/SAT/AO/COM/MOT/SELF/LIFE/Dyadic ownership.
No duplicate measurement operation is retained merely because surface topics overlap; join-only use is preferred where another module already owns the construct.
Adult opt-in, adaptive burden, no unnecessary high-risk operational detail and minimum-join/privacy constraints are part of the architecture.

ownership_boundaries.distinction_ru: RPE — stimulus/preference/reward geometry; SOMA — embodied response/awareness. Сходство темы тела не означает одинаковую measurement operation.
ownership_boundaries.distinction_en: RPE concerns stimulus/preference/reward geometry; SOMA concerns embodied response/awareness. Shared body-related language does not imply the same measurement operation.

ownership_boundaries.distinction_ru: Предпочтение не равно способности обсуждать или согласовывать предпочтение.
ownership_boundaries.distinction_en: A preference is not the same as the ability to communicate or negotiate that preference.

ownership_boundaries.distinction_ru: Предпочтение не равно пользе или downstream-исходу; связь допустима только как последующий research bridge.
ownership_boundaries.distinction_en: Preference is not benefit or a downstream outcome; any relation is a later research bridge only.

modules.next_gate: No public construct-detail activation or respondent scientific report until a separate RPE publication/field evidence authority permits it.

limitations.ru: PASS 10 не является psychometric validation и не разрешает norms, cutoffs, diagnostic labels или archetypes.
limitations.en: PASS 10 is not psychometric validation and authorizes no norms, cutoffs, diagnostic labels or archetypes.

limitations.ru: Detailed construct-family content остаётся внутренним до отдельного publication gate.
limitations.en: Detailed construct-family content remains internal pending a separate publication gate.
A global RPE Total is prohibited.

source_bindings.role: final placement, ownership, publication/fielding and zero-redundancy authority

publication.claim_ceiling: preserve existing minimal role/status/boundary only; detailed architecture withheld by stricter RPE source authority
